children: Centrus Energy executed two agreements to support a new capital raise. The company entered an Underwriting Agreement with Guggenheim Securities to offer 500,000 shares of common stock and issue pre-funded and common warrants covering up to 9.0 million shares. The warrants are immediately exercisable, with pre-funded warrants priced at $0.10 and common warrant exercise prices set across four series. Centrus also appointed U.S. Bank Trust Company as warrant agent to administer issuance and exercises, streamlining investor access and transaction processing.
